question: Can Ukraine's air defence keep up, yes or no?

lines.text: Russia has struck 18 locations across Ukraine overnight, Ukraine's Air Force says.
lines.note: Kyiv Post (Air Force): missiles and drones struck 18 locations, debris fell at five

lines.text: Kyiv was hit in several waves of ballistic missiles, on Putin's 74th birthday.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: Kyiv attacked with ballistic missiles in several waves, first salvo shortly after 3am; Euronews: Putin turned 74

lines.text: The Air Force says Russia launched 130 strike drones and several types of missile.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: ballistic, cruise and anti-ship missiles, alongside 130 strike drones, from 6pm on 6 Oct

lines.text: It says 161 targets were shot down or suppressed, including five ballistic and 39 cruise missiles.
lines.note: Air Force via Kyiv Post: 161 targets, 5 ballistic, 39 cruise, 117 drones

lines.text: Among the weapons, it lists Iskander-M, Zircon, and North Korean KN-23 missiles.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: Iskander-M, S-400 and North Korean KN-23, as well as Zircon and Onyx

lines.text: 38 of the drones downed were jet-powered Shahed types.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: 117 drones incl. 38 jet-powered Shahed-type

lines.text: The attack came from Rostov, Bryansk, Voronezh, the Caspian Sea and Crimea.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: Rostov, Bryansk, Voronezh regions, Caspian Sea, occupied Donetsk and Crimea

lines.text: In Pryluky, a missile hit a five-storey apartment building, and part of it collapsed.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: missile hit a five-story apartment building, large section collapsed

lines.text: Euronews reports at least 12 people were killed across Ukraine.
lines.note: Euronews: at least 12 killed across Ukraine (only toll used)

lines.text: Russia's Defence Ministry says it hit missile and drone plants, and ports in the Odesa region.
lines.note: Euronews: MoD: 'industrial facilities involved in producing and storing missiles and drones, as well as port and ship repair facilities in the Odesa region'

lines.text: Zelensky called it "one of the most vile strikes", and asked allies for more Patriot systems.
lines.note: Euronews: 'one of the most vile strikes'; Kyiv Post: appealed for additional Patriot systems

scene.quote: one of the most vile strikes

lines.text: He says ballistic missiles are the greatest challenge.
lines.note: Euronews: Zelensky said ballistic missiles were 'the greatest challenge'

lines.text: Can Ukraine's air defence keep up, yes or no?

sources.title: Zelensky says Russia missile attack that killed 12 is birthday 'gift' to Putin

caption: Ukraine, Kyiv: Russia has struck 18 locations across Ukraine overnight, on Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday, Ukraine's Air Force says. It says 161 drones and missiles were shot down or suppressed, including five ballistic missiles. Can Ukraine's air defence keep up, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 7 Oct about 00:25 UTC (Kyiv Independent), Reuters 01:45, then Interfax-Ukraine, Kyiv Post, Euronews, Politico, Al Jazeera, Metro, Independent; about 10.5h old at delivery

Removal-risk: event that happened; one attributed toll (Euronews) at line 9, not in hook, first 5s or caption; Zelensky's 'gift' line left out; Romania NATO jets item left out (search returned a recycled Aug 2025 AP story); neutral yes/no
